raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Overview Python logs generated outputs when `--enable-log-outputs` is set, on chat, completions (vllm-project/vllm#62205) and raw generate, with `--enable-log-deltas` (default true) controlling the per-update lines. The Rust frontend declared both flags as unsupported placeholders, so `vllm serve --enable-log-requests --enable-log-outputs` with `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1` failed at startup. This PR implements both. Supersedes inactive vllm-project/vllm#57186 (chat only, last commit 2026-09-17). ## Claims - `--enable-log-outputs` and `--enable-log-deltas` are real Rust frontend flags, also accepted through `--args-json`. As in Python, `--enable-log-outputs` requires `--enable-log-requests`. - With them, Rust logs one line per streamed update (when deltas are on) and one complete line per choice on chat and completions, and the output token IDs on non-streaming raw generate. Each line carries the text and finish reason at INFO and the token IDs at DEBUG, inside the request span. ## Validation Commands from `.buildkite/scripts/run-rust-frontend-cargo-ci.sh` (`style-clippy` and `test`), run from the repo root: ``` cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check # ok cargo sort --workspace --check rust # ok cargo deny --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --config rust/deny.toml check bans # ok cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked -- -D warnings # ok cargo nextest run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-features --locked --no-fail-fast # 2323 tests run: 2323 passed, 13 skipped ``` - Route tests against the mock engine (`routes/tests.rs`, `log_outputs_*`): chat stream (reasoning delta, content delta, complete line), non-streaming chat, completions stream with and without deltas, non-streaming completions, raw generate (token IDs only), and nothing logged when disabled. They capture the `vllm_server::routes::output_log` events through a global test subscriber and mark any event outside a request span. The chat stream ends on `length`, so its last delta line must carry the finish reason. The five logging tests fail with the INFO line removed. - `log_outputs_logs_chat_deltas_sent_before_a_stream_error`: an engine error after `Hello` still logs the held delta. - `log_outputs_logs_chat_text_released_at_finish_with_its_update`: with tools, the parser releases a held-back ` Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide. --- Need help on this PR?
